The verifier's 6 new searches (tumble dryer, clothes dryer spinning, washing machine porthole, black clothes washing machine, pixabay tumble dryer, pixabay washing machine drum) found only laundromats, red/blue clothes (4119968, rejected) or a dark red-lit drum (pixabay 233903, rejected). group_notes: 1) ONE LAUNDRY KIT ACROSS ADS: washer = Pexels 4440711 (white home front-loader, cream towels, fair hand), airer = Coverr 'hanging-up-laundry-6564' (white wire airer, sunny window, wooden pegs, small black items), folded/drawer = Pexels 6792565 + 6793139 (one warm boho bedroom shoot). V1-c S13>S14>S15 and V2-b S13>S14 cut from the same three sources; V2-a S24 uses a later window of the airer clip (18.20-18.75) and V2-c S16 uses Pexels 8756639 (white towels tumbling, with 8756695 from the same laundromat series as a backup) so no two ads share identical frames. 2) GRADE: three different shoots. Warm everything slightly toward the cream palette (#F5EDE6): 4440711 is already neutral-warm; the Coverr airer is backlit and cool, so lift shadows about +15, warm about +300K and HSL-key out the pale-green ring reflection in its window; 8756639 has a grey-blue cast, so warm it and cut blues. 3) RESOLUTION: 4440711 tops out at 1280x720 (the API's 'hd_1920_1080' link also serves 720p), so its 9:16 crop is a 2.67x upscale. Keep it to 0.9 s or less with a light sharpen. Everything else is 1080p or 4K. 4) COMPLIANCE CHECKS DONE: no faces in any chosen window (6793139 shows lips/chin until ~8.9 s, so its window now starts at 9.2; 6792565 shows a face around 14-15 s, outside the window); the readable Russian 'ВНИМАНИЕ!' sticker on 8756639 must be cropped (crop from y=0, height 0.86); no logos or badges in the crops; no water or coloured liquid in any pick (the Pixabay suds clip was removed); no children (rejected all the Pexels laundromat 'boy/girl' clips and the 7705269 teen airer clip). 5) THE BIG CAVEAT: no stock shows our pair. The black items are a charcoal tee (washer), black socks/fabric (airer) and folded black tops (bedroom). At 0.55-0.9 s they read as 'black laundry', which is enough for V1-c (generic routine), but the V2 slots say 'the real underwear'. Fastest upgrade: one 15-minute phone shoot with the CJ samples (SKU CJNSNYNK00343): toss into the drum + door shut, peg on a white airer by a window (and an unpeg-and-lift), a drawer of folded pairs top-down with a hand lifting one, and the pair tumbling behind the closed door. Second-best: the Kling image-to-video fallbacks above, started from a Nano Banana frame built on the PRODUCT-STORE / PRODUCT-REAL refs. 6) LICENCE: Pexels, Coverr and Pixabay only (free commercial use, no attribution). Nothing from Vecteezy, Videvo or Shutterstock. 7) VERIFIER: (a) Door timing in 4440711: the door swings shut at 2.88-3.30, so use that for every "door wipe" (the earlier 2.65-3.00 was arm blur). (b) The Coverr airer is much darker than the washer and bedroom clips. Grade it up (shadows +20, warm) or the laundry run will dip in brightness on "hang". (c) Hand continuity across the V1-c run: washer = fair slim forearm in a light-blue check sleeve; airer = silhouette; bedroom = fair slim hands with bare arms. They read as one woman. Avoid Pexels 10565830 (dark-skinned hands) unless nothing else works. (d) Coverr downloads work with a normal GET (browser/curl), not HEAD. (e) Removed Pixabay 30704 (suds + bright colours).
